transcription.text: There's a hundred thousand dollars in your back seat.
Your last rider left it, soaked jacket, bus station drop off.
You're three months behind on rent.
And tonight the landlord changed your door code.
That bag is four years of rent.
Your rider is calling again and again.
Under the cash, a black ski mask, then a text.
Do you take the mask or walk away?
